detail.longDescription: Quick update on Songs2VID: The self-hosted open-source edition has reached End of Support and no longer receives updates or active maintenance. Managing and maintaining a separate codebase became too much overhead as we focus our energy on the main platform. The repository remains accessible on our Gitea page for informational and archival reference only. Thanks to everyone who tried it out and supported the project! 🙏 Repo: https:// git.atakanozban.com/Songs2VID/ songs2vid # opensource # selfhosted # gitea # indiedev
